about: POST /api/open/v1/door/here, the heartbeat a visible lab page sends every 60 s (AGENT-DOOR A4 rev 2, 4.3). The page sends exactly {page, tab}; the Worker adds only the detector-qualified class and forwards nothing else about the visitor.

fields.tab: 32 lower-case hex (128 random bits held in page memory; not a cookie, not stored by the page)

responses.when: counted (a new tab) or refreshed (a known tab)
anything but exactly {page, tab} with an allowed page and a 32-hex tab
Sec-Fetch-Site present and not same-origin, or an Origin of another site
the platform's rate-limit binding refuses this client prefix (300 a minute), or the API's overall limit
the rate-limit binding is missing or failing (no fallback), presence is not measured on this deployment, or the API can't be reached

page_line: We count active tabs, not people. While a tab is open, we keep its random id, its page, a guess at its type and the time it last checked in. Inactive entries are removed by a scheduled cleanup after the two-minute window. We keep a keyed digest of the tab id until the next cleanup after 00:00 UTC, so we don't count that tab twice today. Restarting the API clears these records. Our hosting provider's network logs may record IP addresses. To limit heartbeats, we pass your network address prefix to our hosting provider's rate-limit service, which counts them in one-minute windows; we keep no copy, and the provider's own policy governs how long its service keeps those counts.

limiter.fallback: none: without a working binding the heartbeat is refused (503 presence_unavailable)
